threshold_note: threshold is rolling (window per lookback, in MONTHS); threshold_value is the latest rolling value — see winner_trade_log.csv for the full path
strategy_description: Long SPY when the lagged NAHB HMI signal is above its threshold; otherwise cash. (Procyclical orientation: strong/improving builder sentiment = risk-on.) Rebalanced MONTHLY.
lead_description: Signal lead = 7 month(s); grid floors at L1 by fleet convention although NAHB's mid-month release FOR the current month makes even L0 lookahead-free

selection.objective_formula: oos_ret.mean()/oos_ret.std()*sqrt(12) — MONTHLY annualization — maximised over the full valid strategy population (SA source: no seasonal-cleanliness restriction; ECON-T4 benchmark excluded); ties resolved by the ECON-T3 cascade
selection.rationale: Maximiser of OOS Sharpe over the full tradable MONTHLY lead grid L1..L12 (12980 valid combos; median valid OOS Sharpe 0.7901). 394-month HMI x SPY overlap gives a 98-month (~8.2yr) OOS window — ABOVE the 5-year reliability floor (a LONG sample by fleet standards), so the found-in-search caveat is materially weaker than short-history pairs, though the winner is still selected from 17856 scanned combos. ECON-LT1 gate: full grid scanned natively -> no staleness possible. Bounded-index guard: winner bounded_pct_risk=False.

notes: Mode 1, feat260706_wells_fargo_housing_spy — MONTHLY bounded-diffusion-index pair.
